title: Half-Day Near Campus: Monastic Peace & Heritage
subtitle: Mindrolling Stupa, Clement Town & Tibetan Cuisine
description: Zero travel stress between conference tracks. A tranquil stroll from Graphic Era Bell Road gate to the 60-meter Great Stupa, spinning prayer wheels, and finishing with authentic tingmo and butter tea.
whyThisOrder: Early morning prayers at Mindrolling before monks' noon recess, followed by leisurely lunch in Tibetan colony.
sunsetNotice: All valley stops; zero hill driving required.

title: Mussoorie in a Day: The 2,290m Summit & Sunset
subtitle: Lal Tibba, Char Dukan, George Everest & Mall Road
description: The quintessential Uttarakhand hill ascent. Early morning tea and waffles at Char Dukan, telescope views of Bandarpoonch peaks at Lal Tibba, and watching the Himalayan Winterline sunset from George Everest cliff.
whyThisOrder: Reaches Lal Tibba early before noon cloud cover gathers; hits George Everest at golden hour; returns via daylight-safe route before dark.
sunsetNotice: Descend Mussoorie toll gate by 5:30 PM to avoid mountain fog.

title: Spiritual Loop: Rishikesh & Haridwar Ganga Aarti
subtitle: Suspension Bridges, Himalayan Riverbank & Sacred Chants
description: Experience where the holy Ganges breaks free from the Himalayas into the plains. Stroll Ram Jhula in Rishikesh, followed by prime seating at the evening Maha Aarti at Triveni Ghat or Har Ki Pauri.
whyThisOrder: Afternoon river exploration along Laxman/Ram Jhula leads seamlessly into evening Ganga Aarti as dusk settles.
sunsetNotice: Smooth 4-lane expressway return to Dehradun via Haridwar bypass.

title: Nature & Canyon Streams: Robber's Cave & FRI
subtitle: Subterranean Limestone River Gorge & Forest Lawns
description: Wade knee-deep through the underground limestone cave stream at Gucchupani where mountain waters vanish into dark rock chambers, then stroll the 450-hectare botanical gardens of FRI.
whyThisOrder: Wade in cave during warmest midday sun (11:00–13:00); spend cooler afternoon under FRI's shaded arbor cloisters.
sunsetNotice: All within valley perimeter; return to Graphic Era in 25 minutes.

title: Foodie Doon: 1953 Bakeries, Momos & Craft Brews
subtitle: From British Colonial Pastries to Rajpur Nightlife
description: Taste Dehradun's legendary culinary legacy: sticky jaws from Ellora's (est. 1953), piping-hot chicken kothay momos at Kalsang Friends Corner, wood-fired pizza at AMA Cafe, and fresh craft microbrews at The Brew Estate.
whyThisOrder: Afternoon heritage tasting and bazaar shopping, concluding with dinner and rooftop drinks along Jakhan.

title: Weekend Deep-Dive: Dhanaulti Deodars & Surkanda Peak
subtitle: High Alpine Forests at 2,757m & Apple Orchards
description: For attendees extending their stay through Monday. Journey past Mussoorie into the deep deodar sanctuaries of Dhanaulti, taking the ropeway to 360-degree snow peaks at Surkanda Devi.
whyThisOrder: Long mountain ascent requires early departure; avoids weekend bottleneck at Mussoorie picture palace.
sunsetNotice: Strict departure from Dhanaulti by 15:30 to descend Shivalik ghats before sunset.
